name: Mehta Securities Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Mehta Securities Ltd is in the business of providing stockbroking 
and investments services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MSL is engaged in offering broking activities, advisory, and consultancy assignments in capital markets. The company is investing its surplus funds in the capital market and other financial instruments for long-term gains. It is a 
member of the Cash & FO segment of the NSE

cons: Stock is trading at 2.86 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 0.76% over last 3 years.
